Renamed `totalAmount` → `grossAmount` across all 6 files that referenced it:

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `api/src/main/java/mn/shop/api/Order.java:15,27` | field + `getTotalAmount()` → `getGrossAmount()` |
| `api/src/main/java/mn/shop/api/OrderDto.java:5,8` | record component + call site |
| `api/src/main/resources/graphql/order.graphqls:4` | schema field |
| `web/src/lib/orders.ts:6,25` | query selection + `Order` interface |
| `web/src/components/OrderSummary.tsx:4,12` | both reads |
| `web/src/generated/graphql-generated.ts:11` | generated `Order` type |

`mvn -o test` passes on the api module. I could not verify the web module — `web/node_modules` is absent and npm has no network here, so neither `tsc --noEmit` nor `vitest` could run.

Four things worth your attention:

- **`graphql-generated.ts` is marked do-not-edit**, but the repo has no codegen config or script (`web/package.json` only has `build`/`test`), so there is nothing here to regenerate it with. I edited it by hand to keep it consistent with the schema — if codegen lives outside this repo, re-run it and take its output over mine.
- **The JPA column name changes.** Under Spring's default naming strategy, `Order.grossAmount` now maps to column `gross_amount` instead of `total_amount`. There are no migrations or `application.properties` in the repo, so there was nothing for me to update, but a real database needs either a migration or `@Column(name = "total_amount")` on the field.
- **This is a breaking GraphQL API change** — any client still querying `totalAmount` will fail. The rename was the ask, so I made it, but it may need coordinating.
- **I left two comments untouched** (`web/src/lib/orders.test.ts:9`, `api/src/test/java/mn/shop/api/OrderDtoTest.java:13`). Both mention `totalAmount` while explaining *why the tests deliberately avoid naming the amount field*, so rewriting them to `grossAmount` would have made them say the wrong thing. Say the word if you'd rather they read as post-rename prose.
